# CHA (Cor's Hardcore Additions) 1.0.1 Release
v1.0.1:

**<ins>Additions</ins>**
- Category page functionally
- More categories
- Changed in-game icon for the mod menu entry!

**<ins>Notes</ins>**
With the usage in a modpack made by EvilSqurrielGuy via discord, more discs were found to have existed than what this mod sees...
Disc creator now sees the full disc mod and adds a second category page to view from
It is untested when the mod is played on it's own however, which might be the next thing to try out

releases.notes:
CHA (Cor's Hardcore Additions) 1.0.0 Relase

Pulls from original 1.21.10 counterpart:
- Disc List
- Music Block

Pulls from WaterBailey v1.0.6:
- Base Music Block Menu
- Categories to filter with
- Base functions from that menu
- Lyrics Button
- Keybind for pulling up the Lyrics Screen based on what disc is inserted inside a jukebox

Improves on or Changes from either:
- Bigger area for main screen
- Updated Lyric's Button Texture
- Lyrics Button now pops out from the bottom of the screen when lyrics are available
- Categories are no longer drawn within code and are moved to be on the left side of the main menu
- Tested in IDE's Test server, proves that opening the Music Block (Named Disc Creator ingame) does NOT crash the server
- Updated main screen's texture
- Added Categories Tab texture that draws the category names ontop
- Category Names are NOT drawn by code, but instead of just textures scaled to fit inside the tab
- Category Tab can be hidden or shown
- Added sound effects within the menu
- Entire Menu has SFX depending on what happens

NOTE
file names will match what is exported straight from the IDE (hardcore_discs-X.X.X.jar)
